scheme_name: Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana
description:
The Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India.

This scheme was launched in the year 2019.

It aims to provide special coaching for the children of sanitation workers.

The primary objective is to enhance the educational opportunities for these children.

The scheme specifically targets the children of those engaged in sanitation work.

The government recognizes the socio-economic challenges faced by sanitation workers.

The initiative is designed to uplift the educational status of their children.

The scheme aims to provide coaching for competitive examinations.

This includes examinations for professional courses and government jobs.

The government has set a measurable target to enroll a significant number of students.

The goal is to ensure that at least 50,000 children benefit from this scheme annually.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial.

Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to INR 50,000 per year.

This amount is allocated for coaching classes and related educational expenses.

The scheme covers various subjects including science, mathematics, and English.

In addition to coaching, the scheme also provides study materials.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined.

Applicants must be children of sanitation workers.

There is no specific age limit mentioned for eligibility.

However, the children must be enrolled in schools or colleges.

The income criteria for the sanitation workers is also specified.

The annual income of the sanitation worker should not exceed INR 3 lakh.

This ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections.

The application process for the scheme is straightforward.

Interested applicants must fill out an application form.

This form can be obtained from designated government offices.

The required documents include proof of identity and income.

Additionally, a certificate confirming the parent's occupation is necessary.

Applicants must also provide their educational certificates.

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the local authority.

The local authority will verify the documents and eligibility.

After verification, the application will be forwarded to the implementing agency.

The disbursement of funds occurs on a yearly basis.

The funds are released directly to the coaching institutions.

This ensures that the financial assistance is utilized for educational purposes.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The ministry has designated specific nodal agencies for effective implementation.

These agencies are responsible for monitoring and evaluating the scheme.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of education for social upliftment.

It aims to break the cycle of poverty among sanitation workers' families.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for this scheme.

This budget is intended to cover the expenses for multiple years.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote social justice.

It aligns with the government's commitment to inclusive education.

The coaching provided under this scheme is tailored to meet the needs of students.

It focuses on enhancing their skills and knowledge for competitive exams.

The scheme also encourages the participation of private coaching institutions.

This collaboration aims to provide quality education to the beneficiaries.

The government regularly reviews the progress of the scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the program.

The scheme has received positive responses from various stakeholders.

It is seen as a step towards empowering marginalized communities.

The initiative also aims to create awareness about the importance of education.

Workshops and seminars are organized to promote the scheme.

The government encourages local communities to support the initiative.

This includes awareness campaigns in schools and colleges.

The scheme also aims to foster a sense of pride among sanitation workers.

It highlights the essential services provided by sanitation workers.

The government has established a helpline for queries related to the scheme.

This helpline is available for beneficiaries to seek assistance.

The contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment are publicly available.

The ministry's website provides comprehensive information about the scheme.

Regular updates and notifications are posted to keep beneficiaries informed.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare programs.

It complements other initiatives aimed at improving the living standards of marginalized groups.

The government is committed to ensuring that no child is left behind in education.

Through this scheme, the government aims to create equal opportunities for all.

The Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana is a vital step towards achieving this goal.

In conclusion, this scheme represents the government's dedication to social equity.

It strives to empower the children of sanitation workers through education.

The initiative is a beacon of hope for many families striving for a better future.
